verdict.rationale: Zep's open-source component is Graphiti, a temporal knowledge graph framework that can be run locally (zep-docs-15, zep-docs-52, zep-gh-1, zep-comm-2). The full Zep memory platform is offered as Cloud or 'Your VPC' deployment (zep-docs-17), and the quick start installs a cloud SDK (zep-docs-47). So the self-hostable piece is a framework, not the complete managed memory layer, and the VPC option is not shown to come from open-source code. Missing for 10: evidence that the full Zep memory layer is open-source and self-hostable, Docker or other deployment documentation, details of the VPC option, and independent hands-on self-hosting reports.
